title: Fall of the College of Lat-Nam

entities.name: Fall of the College of Lat-Nam
entities.description: Event in the Brothers' War that left the first school of magic in ruins.

entities.name: College of Lat-Nam
entities.description: The first school of magic on Terisiare, founded by Drafna and Hurkyl.

entities.name: Drafna
entities.description: Co-founder who survived and founded a new school in the City of Shadows.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: Co-founder killed in the fall of Terisia City.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Besieged Terisia City; uninterested in magic.

entities.name: Terisia City
entities.description: City of the Third Path that fell in 45 AR.

entities.name: Third Path
entities.description: Scholars who smuggled relics out of Terisia City.

entities.name: Loran
entities.description: Traveled elsewhere with the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: Wizard who purified the site 4000 years later.

events.summary: Terisia City falls after Mishra's siege; Hurkyl is killed.
events.quote: Hurkyl was among those who were killed

events.summary: Drafna removes valuable artifacts, leaving only books for Mishra, who is enraged.
events.quote: leaving only books and scrolls for Mishra to find

events.summary: The College of Lat-Nam is laid waste, becoming a poisoned glass desert for 4000 years.
Drafna and others survive and found a hidden new school in the City of Shadows.
events.quote: Drafna and others of the Third Path survived

relations.quote: where Drafna and Hurkyl had established the College of Lat-Nam many years earlier
Mishra set his eyes on Terisia City and eventually caused its downfall after months of siege
